description_en: Provisions a CIDR block for an IPAM pool
kebab_example: aliyun vpcipam add-ipam-pool-cidr --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipam-pool-id ipam-pool-6rcq3tobayc20t0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddIpamPoolCidr

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the IPAM hosted region.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
IPAM托管地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the IPAM pool
parameters.name: ipam_pool_id

parameters.help_en:
The CIDR block to provision.

Private top-level pools support provisioning only by specifying a CIDR block
parameters.help_zh:
要预置的CIDR地址段。

私网顶级池仅支持通过输入CIDR地址段的方式进行预置
parameters.name: cidr

parameters.help_en:
Provisions a CIDR block by specifying a netmask length.

Public IPv6 top-level pools support provisioning only by specifying a netmask length
parameters.help_zh:
通过掩码的方式预置CIDR地址段。

公网IPv6顶级池仅支持通过掩码的方式进行预置
parameters.name: netmask_length

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without provisioning a CIDR block for the IPAM pool. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and business limits. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code DryRunOperation is returned.
false (default): sends the request. After the check succeeds, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会为IPAM地址池预置CIDR地址段。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码DryRunOperation。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. A client-generated value that is unique across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId is different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

Cidr.description_en: The CIDR block that is successfully provisioned for the IPAM pool
Cidr.description_zh: 地址池成功预置的CIDR地址段
